profile.name: Proton Nazar
profile.title: Senior FullStack JavaScript & Web3 Developer
profile.description: I'm a Senior FullStack Developer with over four years of experience, driven by curiosity and the pursuit of excellence. I'm dedicated to continuous growth, eagerly expanding my skills and knowledge, and thriving in dynamic team settings. Challenges inspire me, and I approach each project believing any goal is achievable. Ready to contribute my expertise, I'm excited to bring impactful solutions to a forward-thinking team.

experience.description: Building Web3 job marketplace platform connecting Web3 specialists with projects, featuring resume-based talent search and comprehensive vetting system. Currently in active development phase, implementing rapid deployment matching and success tracking features.

Developed Telegram mini-app and website gambling platform, significantly optimizing performance and user experience. Enhanced animations, improved display rendering, and implemented comprehensive performance optimizations that dramatically increased project speed and responsiveness.

Building AI-powered app generation platform that creates applications from text prompts in containers, with direct Google Play Store publishing capabilities. Currently in development phase, implementing containerized deployment system and automated app building pipeline.
Built self-evolving AI systems that autonomously develop and improve themselves. Developed machine learning frameworks for continuous self-optimization and autonomous growth capabilities.
Built manual agent creation system with detailed configuration options, including text and voice chat interfaces. Created fine-tuned control settings for agent behavior and performance optimization.

Contributed to diverse client projects at BlackStack Labs, consistently delivering high-quality and efficient solutions while optimizing code for performance and stability. Enhanced integration processes and met project goals on schedule, ensuring client satisfaction with each deployment.

Acted as the sole developer in building an NFT marketplace with features like NFT migration, trading, and analytics. Developed complex UI effects and worked closely with designers to create an appealing user experience, focusing on seamless navigation and functionality.

Worked across multiple roles, including Full Stack and React Native developer, supporting well-known companies in creating impactful solutions that benefit humanity. Contributed to projects such as AI-driven security tools, investment platforms, and corporate applications, adding meaningful features and maintaining high standards of performance.

Contributed to a crypto fund platform, integrating smart contracts for staking, minting, and redeeming, and creating interactive dashboards. Developed two versions of their website independently and implemented a streamlined system for managing smart contracts, making processes more accessible and efficient.

Worked as part of a team on various client projects, focusing on building responsive, interactive interfaces and enhancing user engagement. Contributed innovative ideas and solutions for improved functionality and design, significantly enhancing user satisfaction.

Served as the lead developer, creating a staking and investment platform with Vue.js, focusing on user experience, cross-browser compatibility, and smooth interaction for crypto enthusiasts. Ensured a seamless and intuitive experience for end users.
